cyber_lawsuits.outcome: Settled for $60 million (covered by D&O insurance); court granted final approval and dismissed the case with prejudice; settlement did not constitute an admission of fault
cyber_lawsuits.value: In re Okta, Inc. Securities Litigation, No. 3:22-cv-02990 (N.D. Cal.) — securities class action alleging false/misleading statements about Okta's cybersecurity controls, breach vulnerability, and Auth0 integration

moveit_evidence.value: Okta's Security team stated: "Okta is not impacted by CVE-2023-34362. The affected MOVEit version is not used anywhere in production (or internal) services."

past_breaches.value: January-March 2022: Threat actor group LAPSUS$ claimed access to Okta's internal systems via a third-party support engineer's account; Okta's handling and disclosure of the incident was later the subject of an SEC-related securities class action.

September 28 – October 17, 2023: Attacker used a stolen credential to access Okta's customer support case management system; initially reported to affect 134 (about 1%) of customers, later expanded to affect essentially all customer support system users, including confirmed downstream impact to BeyondTrust, Cloudflare, and 1Password.

service_description.value: Okta provides Single Sign-On (SSO) to secure access to cloud and on-premises applications from any device, as part of its broader identity and access management platform which also includes Adaptive MFA, API Access Management, Universal Directory, and Identity Governance.

service_implementation.value: Delivered via the cloud-based Okta Identity Cloud platform, which customers' employees, contractors, and end users sign into to securely access applications from any device.

supplier_description.value: Okta, Inc. (formerly SaaSure Inc.) is a publicly traded (Nasdaq: OKTA) American identity and access management company headquartered in San Francisco, California, founded in 2009 by Todd McKinnon and Frederic Kerrest, providing cloud-based identity solutions including Single Sign-On.
